slides.title: The Application Cycle Is Live
slides.content: Year 2 is no longer about exploring possibilities. It is about: Making applications. Meeting deadlines. Using evidence. Making decisions. Progression is now active, not theoretical.

slides.title: Dates Matter
slides.content: Major deadlines include: UCAS applications. Apprenticeship applications. Internal reference deadlines. Predicted grade deadlines. The key message is: Early beats on-time. On-time is the new late.

slides.title: Navigate Becomes Application Material
slides.content: Your Navigate record should now supply: UCAS content. Apprenticeship evidence. Portfolio evidence. References. Interview preparation. Year 2 is about using the evidence collected in Year 1.

exercise.prompt: Which of the following are mentioned in 'Navigate Becomes Application Material'? Select all that apply.

slides.title: Audit Your Record
slides.content: Ask yourself: Is my Digital CV current? Are projects fully logged? Are placements recorded? Is my skills evidence visible? Gaps become harder to fix later.
